summary: Call MCP tools with ansible.mcp.run_tool using the ansible.mcp.mcp connection, ansible_mcp_server_name matching mcpserver.json and connect/command timeouts; secrets such as a GitHub PAT come from a custom credential type injecting MCP_BEARER_TOKEN.
questions: How do I call an MCP tool from a playbook?
What connection plugin does ansible.mcp use?
How do I pass a GitHub token to the MCP server?

answer_card.title: Call an MCP tool from a playbook
answer_card.answer_md:
```
- name: Example GitHub MCP server interaction
  hosts: github_mcp
  tasks:
    - name: Create a GitHub repository
      ansible.mcp.run_tool:
        name: create_repository
        args:
          name: my-github-repository
          autoInit: true
```

Inventory vars: `ansible_connection: ansible.mcp.mcp`, `ansible_mcp_server_name` (a server in `mcpserver.json`), `ansible_connect_timeout: 30`, `ansible_command_timeout: 30`. Provide the token through a custom credential type that injects `MCP_BEARER_TOKEN`.
